# Central Tax Collection System (CTCS)

## Project Overview

Central Tax Collection System (CTCS) is an enterprise municipal taxation application developed as an MCA Dissertation Project.

The objective is to provide a centralized platform to manage citizens, municipal assets, tax assessment, payments and reports.

---

# Technology Stack

Frontend

- React.js
- Material UI
- React Router
- Axios

Backend

- Node.js
- Express.js
- SQLite

Architecture

- REST APIs
- JWT Authentication
- Controller → Service → Repository Pattern
- Modular Architecture
